meta.title: Chefchaouen Blue City Day Trip | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A full-day shared trip from Fes to Chefchaouen's blue-washed medina, the Kasbah Museum, and Plaza Uta el-Hammam. From €39pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared day trip from Fes to the blue-washed streets of Chefchaouen. From €39pp.

hero.lead: Fes → Rif Mountains → Chefchaouen Medina → Free Time → Fes

paras: Chefchaouen's blue-washed lanes are the single most-booked day trip from Fes. A shared minivan covers the roughly 3.5-hour drive each way through the green hills of the Rif Mountains, with a full afternoon to wander the town's photogenic streets.
A guided walk covers the winding blue alleyways, the Kasbah Museum, and the main square (Plaza Uta el-Hammam), followed by free time for rooftop cafés and local weaving workshops.
chips: 🚗 ≈400 km round trip · about 7 hrs driving
🗓 Departs daily, book ahead in high season

price.sub: per person · departs daily, book ahead in high season

good.h2: Book a few days ahead in peak season
paras: This is our most-booked route from Fes, so seats can sell out several days ahead in high season (October–April). Booking early is recommended.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure time, final price, and pickup details by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: How much free time is there in Chefchaouen?
items.a: A full afternoon after the guided walk — usually 3–4 hours to explore, shop, and photograph the blue streets at your own pace.

items.q: Is this the same as the Chefchaouen leg on the multi-day tours?
items.a: It's the same destination, but as a single day trip you don't get an overnight stay. See our 4-Day Fes, Chefchaouen & Volubilis Tour for two full nights there instead.
Modest, comfortable clothing and good walking shoes — the medina is built on a hillside with plenty of steps and slopes.
